name: vintage-story-server-manager
description: Administer Vintage Story servers through a local or hosted Manager with shared MCP and CLI tools.

interface.shortDescription: Manage servers, mods, players and backups.
interface.longDescription: Connect to your Manager to inspect servers, install compatible mods, manage players, edit configuration, manage backups and investigate operations. Uses your existing Manager permissions and keeps credentials outside the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Show my servers and investigate any failed activities.
Install the highest compatible version of a mod.
Whitelist a player on my Vintage Story server.
